title: Stellar Swap
tagline: A swap on Stellar chain with integration with ETH, here you can swap silver coin with ethereum
description:
A swap on Stellar chain with integration with ETH, here you can swap silver coin with ethereum, 
Here i have added wallet integration using rainbow kit that have integration with many chains like Ethereum and polygon but mostly we are using Ethereum for this project, for the coin i have choosed silver coin which is in the contract i have added the basic UI Right now for the coin to see if the MINTING and BURNING of coin is working or not
how_its_made:
I have make this project from scratch
for the Frontend i have used tech stack of next.js with typescript and for the UI library i used shadcn, i have added wallet integration using rainbow kit that have integration with many chains like Ethereum and polygon but mostly we are using Ethereum for this project
